faisalabad|2026-11-14.en:
Faisalabad's 24-hour mean PM2.5 is 88 micrograms per cubic metre, and the US EPA AQI is 174, which is Unhealthy. There is a 0% chance that the next 24 hours are hazardous (AQI above 300). The main reasons are air pressure, time of year, and cloud cover.
Residents should limit outdoor activities, especially children, the elderly, and people with asthma, who need to take extra care.
Stay indoors as much as possible and keep windows closed.

multan|2026-11-14.en:
Multan 24-hour mean PM2.5 is 197 micrograms per cubic metre, giving a US EPA AQI of 272 (Very Unhealthy), with a 21% chance that the next 24 hours are hazardous (AQI above 300).
The main reasons are the average pm2.5 over the last 24 hours, the rise in pm2.5 since yesterday, and fires within 300 km in the last 3 days.
Everyone should avoid outdoor exertion, while children, the elderly, and people with asthma take extra care.
